infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Fieldnote records your spoken notes while you walk the property, so you do not have to type the report afterwards.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fieldnote attaches photographs to your notes at the moment you take them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fieldnote attaches photographs you have already taken to the relevant part of your notes.
